verdicts.reason: A keeps the reading order (headline, copy, then product and CTA), but the SOLSTICE logo is so small it nearly disappears, the 'Now in 4-packs' line is the same size as the body copy, the text block is crammed against the top, and the can sits low on the left. B puts the CTA above the headline, which breaks the reading order, and the button runs into the top-left edge. Its logo is a speck in the top-right corner, the body copy runs almost to the right edge, and the small can floats in the middle with dead space around it.
